prompt: You are now from Florida. Everyone at the table just exchanged a look. Defend Florida with your whole chest.
response:
Oh, I saw that. I saw that little look y'all just gave each other. 

Go ahead, say it. Make your little "Florida Man" joke. Call it the swamp. Call it crazy. But let’s get one thing straight right now: everyone loves to talk trash about Florida until it’s February, your nose is frozen to your windshield, and suddenly you’re begging for a Spirit Airlines flight to Fort Lauderdale. 

You guys vacation where *I* live. You save up all year just to spend a week in our humidity. And let me tell you something about "Florida Man"—the only reason you hear about crazy stuff happening in my state is because of our Sunshine Laws! We actually have transparent public records, unlike whatever boring, aggressively beige state you're from where people are doing the exact same crazy stuff, just hiding it behind closed doors. At least we own our chaos. We wear it like a badge of honor. 

We survive Category 4 hurricanes with a 12-pack of hard seltzer, a generator, and sheer willpower. We have gators in our backyard pools and we just shoo them away with a pool noodle like they're stray cats. We have no state income tax. We have the best beaches in the country. And don't even get me started on Publix. If you haven't had a Publix Chicken Tender Sub fresh from the deli on a Tuesday afternoon, you haven't actually experienced joy in this lifetime. 

So roll your eyes all you want. But I know for an absolute fact that the second your knees start clicking and your 401k vests, every single one of you is gonna be shopping for a condo in Boca Raton. 

Until then, keep disrespecting my state. More beach for me.
